title: Sculpted Lower
description: Complete legs and glutes workout with Bulgarian split squats, single-leg hip thrust and core stability

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Jog in place, heels kicking toward glutes

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot side to side

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squats
exercises.instructions: Back foot on a chair, lower the knee

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust
exercises.instructions: Hip thrust on one leg, other leg in the air

exercises.name: Good morning
exercises.instructions: Hands behind head, hinge forward keeping back straight

exercises.name: Bear hold
exercises.instructions: On all fours, knees 2cm off the floor, hold position

exercises.name: Bicycle crunches
exercises.instructions: Elbow to opposite knee alternating, leg extended

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.instructions: On one forearm, body aligned, hips high

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
